permitted_scope: Source-image reprojection diagnostics for separable flat disk families; no motion or gravity scoring.
model: Exact integration of finer bilinear source nodes into the SAME 129 by 129 measured image cells; Laplace minor-axis kernel for each fixed height. No rebinning of target, coverage, radius or weights.

source_fit.initial_condition: zero for every candidate; no warm start from response or other fits
source_fit.stationarity: RMS of L times projected step over all latent nodes, multiplied by refinement squared; normalized source intensity
source_fit.regularization_convention: same lambda times sum of squared nearest-neighbor differences; approximates the same 2D gradient energy on square uniform grids
source_fit.lipschitz_bound: product of maximum row sum and column sum for each nonnegative axis operator, plus 8 lambda

interpretation: Heights are illustrative model alternatives, not independent measurements or posterior draws.
No best-height selection: all candidates, convergence failures and source residuals retained.
Input maps contain different native beams. Only an effective beam-blurred source is represented; no joint beam matching or deconvolution.
Coverage-weighted fitting is not a likelihood; partial native-pixel masks within coarse cells remain an approximation.
Fitted source light is evaluated on the same source data; these are closure diagnostics, not independent predictions.
The source axis, masks, support, penalty and gates are fixed before these source closure results; no velocity data are read.
Distance/conversion/geometry alternatives from generic-source-001 still apply; this first height pass uses nominal geometry only.
Finer source coefficients are latent parameters, not finer observations; this experiment cannot establish superresolution or true 3D structure.
Node-center support radius stays 6 kpc; bilinear hats extend by one latent spacing past a support node. Inner 3 kpc reporting remains far from that boundary.
Resolution dependence is reported for every component and height; no candidate is selected to improve a gravity response.
backend: CuPy float64; cap default memory pool at 1 GiB; no claim of speedup
